mapper.sql: apr07_alt_appr_id AS alt_appr_id, apr07_target_emp_id AS target_emp_id, tgt.emp01_emp_no AS target_emp_no, tgt.emp01_kor_nm AS target_emp_name, f_get_empTrans(tgt.emp01_person_id, apr07_close_date::date, 'org_code_nm') AS target_org_name, f_get_empTrans(tgt.emp01_person_id, apr07_close_date::date, 'title_nm') AS target_title_name, apr07_alt_emp_id AS alt_emp_id, org.emp01_emp_no AS alt_emp_no, org.emp01_kor_nm AS alt_emp_name, f_get_empTrans(org.emp01_person_id, apr07_close_date::date, 'org_code_nm') AS alt_org_name, f_get_empTrans(org.emp01_person_id, apr07_close_date::date, 'title_nm') AS alt_title_name, apr07_start_date::date AS start_date, apr07_close_date::date AS close_date, COALESCE(apr07_stamp_yn, 'false') AS stamp_yn, apr07_reason_cd AS reason_cd, apr07_emgr_point AS emgr_point, apr07_note AS note
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT , apr07_start_date AS sort_start_date FROM apr07_alt_appr INNER JOIN emp01_person tgt ON tgt.emp01_person_id = apr07_target_emp_id INNER JOIN emp01_person org ON org.emp01_person_id = apr07_alt_emp_id WHERE tgt.emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND ( apr07_start_date BETWEEN f_trunc(#{startDate}) AND f_trunc(#{endDate}) OR apr07_close_date BETWEEN f_trunc(#{startDate}) AND f_trunc(#{endDate}) ) ) t WHERE target_emp_name LIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY sort_start_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apr07_alt_appr ( apr07_alt_appr_id, apr07_target_emp_id, apr07_start_date, apr07_close_date, apr07_alt_emp_id, apr07_reason_cd, apr07_emgr_point, apr07_note, apr07_stamp_yn ) SELECT #{req.altApprId}, #{req.targetEmpId}, #{req.startDate}, #{req.closeDate}, #{req.altEmpId}, #{req.reasonCd}, #{req.emgrPoint}, #{req.note}, #{req.stampYn} WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM emp01_person WHERE emp01_person_id = #{req.targetEmpId} AND emp01_company_id = #{companyId}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM emp01_person WHERE emp01_person_id = #{req.altEmpId} AND emp01_company_id = #{companyId})
mapper.update: UPDATE apr07_alt_appr SET apr07_target_emp_id = #{req.targetEmpId}, apr07_start_date = #{req.startDate}, apr07_close_date = #{req.closeDate}, apr07_alt_emp_id = #{req.altEmpId}, apr07_reason_cd = #{req.reasonCd}, apr07_emgr_point = #{req.emgrPoint}, apr07_note = #{req.note}, apr07_stamp_yn = #{req.stampYn} WHERE apr07_alt_appr_id = #{req.altApprId} AND apr07_target_emp_id IN (SELECT emp01_person_id FROM emp01_person WHERE emp01_company_id = #{companyId}) AND #{req.targetEmpId} IN (SELECT emp01_person_id FROM emp01_person WHERE emp01_company_id = #{companyId})
